description: Schema definitions only; tests insert synthetic data. No tenant records or credentials.

production.tenantConfigSql:
CREATE TABLE tenant_config (
    tenant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    
    line_channel_token TEXT,          
    line_channel_secret TEXT,         
    liff_id TEXT,
    liff_url TEXT,
    
    groq_api_key TEXT,
    groq_model TEXT DEFAULT 'llama-3.1-8b-instant',
    openrouter_api_key TEXT,
    openrouter_model TEXT DEFAULT 'google/gemini-2.5-flash:free',
    
    brand_name TEXT NOT NULL,         
    brand_color TEXT DEFAULT '#00b900',
    store_address TEXT,
    
    operating_hours TEXT,             
    delivery_policy TEXT,             
    quick_replies TEXT,               
    flex_template TEXT,               
    default_password TEXT DEFAULT '12345678',
    locale TEXT DEFAULT 'zh-TW',      
    
    google_sheets_url TEXT,
    
    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, allow_scheduled_pickup INTEGER DEFAULT 1, store_status TEXT DEFAULT 'open', logo_url TEXT, announcement TEXT DEFAULT NULL, allow_dine_in INTEGER DEFAULT 1, features TEXT DEFAULT '[]', order_prefix TEXT DEFAULT NULL, latitude REAL, longitude REAL, cuisine_type TEXT DEFAULT 'vietnamese', is_marketplace_visible INTEGER DEFAULT 1, ai_order_redirect_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, staff_ordering_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, customer_order_domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy'
  CHECK (customer_order_domain IN ('legacy', 'blabfood')), legacy_liff_endpoint_url TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

staffObjects.name: orders_staff_revision_guard
staffObjects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER orders_staff_revision_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF revision ON orders
WHEN NEW.revision < 0
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'REVISION_CONFLICT: CHECK constraint failed: revision >= 0');
END
